nodes.label: Bog and Hedgerow Landscape
nodes.evidence_status: Bog types, turf tools, deforestation range, waterways, and corrected regional geography are explicitly fact-checked.
nodes.rationale: Raised bog, turf, sparse woodland, biodiverse hedgerows, drumlins, loughs, and rivers formed both livelihood infrastructure and a charged sense of place.

nodes.label: Landscape as Active Character
nodes.rationale: Season, weather, wildlife, foraging, danger, and travel constraints should make terrain an active simulation force rather than neutral backdrop.
